# Wafer_Scale_Integration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-22

## Definition
The fabrication and interconnection of many dies or chiplets on a full wafer to form a single large-scale computing system. It enables dense, low-latency interconnect topologies required for TCC and large-scale SNN deployment.
